cell-atlas: Use case: scientific-educational. ORIGINAL portable artwork atlas for anatomy game. Attached reference is ONLY drawing style reference: dark indigo hand-ink outlines, rich coloured-pencil crosshatching, bright pink/purple/blue/yellow highlights as in student's lecture notes. Plain clean WHITE background, no notebook ruling, no labels, NO TEXT, NO grid lines, NO shadows. 1536x2048 atlas in EXACT 3 columns and 4 equal-height rows: 12 independent cells. Each drawing centered in its cell, occupying middle 70%, with generous white gutters so cropping cannot include adjacent pieces. Use consistently readable, bold compact anatomy icons; drawings may be purposefully magnified to teach anatomy. Order precisely LEFT-TO-RIGHT then TOP-TO-BOTTOM. Cells: 1 cluster of pink phospholipid molecules, each one water-facing spherical head and TWO gold wavy tails. 2 clear blue droplet of water with small red-and-white water molecules within. 3 coiled pink/blue double-helix DNA. 4 purple circular double nuclear envelope with pores and empty interior, cutaway. 5 same envelope enclosing coiled DNA as a complete nucleus. 6 CLOSED spherical blue watery membrane bag with thick pink lipid boundary and empty blue fluid interior; three-quarter cutaway showing rear wall and enclosing bottom; nucleus must NOT be present. 7 several pink spindle-shaped muscle precursor cells with purple nuclei and internal pulling fibres. 8 golden calcium-phosphate crystals beside a mineral chip, no rock landscape. 9 a compact pink-and-blue full human upper-body anatomy cutaway emblem (for square story icon). 10 small purple nucleus suitable for fitting INSIDE cell from cell6, DNA inside. 11 folded mitochondrion. 12 leave empty pure white. Keep cell 6 large circular open cutaway with usable interior.
